As per United Nations data, what percentage of world’s population was estimated to live in urban settlements in 2016?
x: As per United Nations ‘World Urbanization Prospects 2016’, about 54.5 percent of world’s population was estimated to live in urban settlements in 2016. According to UN-Habitat’s ‘World Cities Report, 2024’, 56.2 percent at world’s population lives in urban area in mid-year 2020, while estimated this estimated to rise to 60.4 percent by the mid-year 2030. As per the World Bank data 58 percent of World’s total population lives in urban area in 2024. According to ‘World Urbanization Prospects, 2025’ report, the aggregating estimates of urban population across disparate national definitions suggests that 58 percent of the world’s population lives in urban areas in 2025, which is well below the combined population (81%) of cities (45 percent) and towns (36 percent) according to the Degree of Urbanization.

s: As per the UN-Habitat’s Global Report on Human Settlements 2009, which one among the following regions has shown the fastest growth rate of urbanization in the last three decades?
x: According to the United Nations-Habitat’s Global report on Human Settlement 2009, Asia has had the fastest growth rate of urbanization in the last three decades.
